claims: Leonardo DiCaprio has won one Academy Award out of six acting nominations.
Leonardo DiCaprio won Best Actor for his role as Hugh Glass in The Revenant (2015).
Leonardo DiCaprio won Best Actor at the 88th Academy Awards in 2016.
Leonardo DiCaprio received a Supporting Actor nomination for What's Eating Gilbert Grape (1994).
Leonardo DiCaprio received an Actor nomination for The Aviator (2005).
Leonardo DiCaprio received an Actor nomination for Blood Diamond (2007).
Leonardo DiCaprio received an Actor nomination for The Wolf of Wall Street (2014).
Leonardo DiCaprio received an Actor nomination for Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood (2020).
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Best Picture as a producer for The Wolf of Wall Street.
